archie_1.text: You mentioned a bloke called James. When can we sort that?
Already arranged. Tomorrow — SE1 4YA, storage unit behind the Costcutter. Midday.
Fair warning: James is the best craftsman I know and also the worst person I know. Don't take it personally. He's like that with everyone.

archie_2.text: Got some calc to move. You got a buyer?
Yeah give me a day or two. What type and how much?
Sorted. I'll bell you. Don't go anywhere daft in the meantime.
Actually — you free tonight? Got someone lined up already. Shoreditch. Easy job.
